_comment: Expectations for Test-VhcLiveRun.ps1 -Check CsvOutputs. Keys are CSV names without the hostname prefix, leading underscore and .csv (Servers = <host>_Servers.csv). The CSV list itself is enumerated from the collector source; this file only says which CSVs must exist and be non-empty. Anything not listed is feature-dependent: may be absent, but must have a valid header when present. Export-VhciCsv writes no file for zero records, so a listed CSV that is missing means its collector found nothing or failed.

required.vbrinfo: every VBR server reports its version (Get-VhcVbrInfo always emits one row)
required.Servers: every VBR server lists at least itself (Get-VBRServer)
required.Proxies: every VBR server has a default VMware backup proxy
required.Repositories: every VBR server has at least the Default Backup Repository
required.Jobs: the labs run jobs; an empty Jobs.csv means job discovery broke (also asserted by RowCounts)
required.LicInfo: every VBR server has a license object (Community edition included)
required.SecurityCompliance: Security & Compliance Analyzer always returns best-practice rows on VBR 12+
required.UserRoles: every VBR server has at least the installing admin role assignment
required.configBackup: every VBR server has a configuration backup job object (enabled or not)
required.orphanedSupersededBackupsMeta: one-row signal file, written unconditionally by Get-VhcOrphanedSupersededBackups
required.AllServersRequirementsComparison: concurrency analysis emits a row for every server role; written on all three labs
required.CollectionManifest: written unconditionally at the end of Get-VBRConfig.ps1 (not in the collector log, so not observed in run 38980131816)
